# Walnut Grove Animal Hospital

> A veterinary clinic in Langley, British Columbia, caring for dogs, cats and small pets.

- Address: 101A-20995 88 Ave, Langley, BC V1M 2C9, Canada
- Phone: (604) 888-2628
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30am to 7:00pm; Saturday and Sunday 9:00am to 5:00pm
- Website: https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com

## Services
- [Preventive care and wellness exams](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/preventative-care)
- [Vaccines](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/vaccines)
- [Puppy and kitten care](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/puppy-kitten-care)
- [Dental care](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/dental-services)
- [Surgery](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/pet-surgery) and [spay and neuter](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/spay-neuter)
- [X-ray](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/pet-x-ray), [ultrasound](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/ultrasound-services), [bloodwork](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/bloodwork) and [lab services](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/lab-services)
- [Parasite prevention](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/parasite-prevention) and [microchipping](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/microchipping)
- [Pet boarding](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/pet-boarding-services)
- [Small mammal medicine](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services/small-mammal-medicine)
- [All services](https://www.walnutgroveanimalclinic.com/services)
